title: Watersound West "Captain's Tower" 21 Clove Hitch Lane
h1: Watersound West "Captain's Tower" 21 Clove Hitch Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool heating and cooling is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $50 per day.- Resort-Style Community Pool- 6-Passenger LSV Golf Cart- Captain’s Tower with stunning views- Private Heated or Cooled Pool **Pool Temperatures can be adjusted for an additional $ Fee per day - Green Egg Grill- Propane grill- Enclosed Outdoor Shower- Screened-in front porch with Brazilian wood floors- Carriage House- 5 Adult bikes- Parking with a garage and driveway space for up to three vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: When the beach beckons, escape to Captain’s Tower, a charming 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home that sleeps 11 guests in the exclusive WaterSound West community. Boasting a private pool and nestled a half-mile from beach access with a private boardwalk through Deer Lake State Park to the breathtaking, pristine beaches and turquoise water, this inviting property is perfect for relaxing, sun-soaked vacations. When not unwinding by the water, guests can take advantage of the resort-style amenities and Iconic 30A’s abundant family-friendly activities!Step inside this custom home to discover an inspired coastal setting, accented by classic beach materials of rattan, shiplap, and natural wood. The living space’s cloud-soft sofa, 2 barrel armchairs, and Smart TV encourage gathering for movie nights. Mere steps away, the gourmet kitchen features premium appliances and an expansive island. Imagine evenings preparing local seafood to share at the 5-seat dining table to the side, with additional seating at the breakfast bar. Out the French doors, breathe in the salt-tinged air from the comfortably furnished screened porch. Flourishing flora offers privacy for the private pool and tanning shelf in the backyard, while the enclosed outdoor shower makes rinsing off after trips to the beach a breeze. Guests can choose to unwind for the night in the primary bedroom with a king bed or the guest bedroom featuring a queen bed and queen trundle. For additional convenience, all the home’s bedrooms feature private bathrooms.Venture up the metal-and-wood staircase to find a second primary bedroom with a soft king bed, alongside a well-appointed office that doubles as a guest bedroom with a desk and queen sleeper sofa.A spiral staircase winds up to the cozy lookout tower—curl up with a book and enjoy the bird’s-eye view.The light-filled Carriage House boasts a full kitchen, 2-person bar, and a cozy living space, plus 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and private bathroom.Indulge in a peaceful, fun WaterSound West getaway at Captain’s Tower. For dedicated beach access, follow the boardwalk from the front porch, and enjoy a leisurely stroll to the sugar-white sands! The nearest public beach access is a 5-minute bike ride to Walton Dunes. On-site parking for up to 4 vehicles, a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, and 5 complimentary adult bikes make exploring 30A easy and convenient. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 11):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Queen Trundle, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Second Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom/Office: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Living Room and Full Kitchen*The fireplaces in this home are not for guest use.*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watersound West "Captain's Tower" 21 Clove Hitch Lane Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 5 Beds 6 Sleeps 11 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private pool *Pool heating and cooling is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $50 per day. - Resort-Style Community Pool - 6-Passenger LSV Golf Cart - Captain’s Tower with stunning views - Private Heated or Cooled Pool **Pool Temperatures can be adjusted for an additional $ Fee per day - Green Egg Grill - Propane grill - Enclosed Outdoor Shower - Screened-in front porch with Brazilian wood floors - Carriage House - 5 Adult bikes - Parking with a garage and driveway space for up to three vehicles - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: When the beach beckons, escape to Captain’s Tower, a charming 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home that sleeps 11 guests in the exclusive WaterSound West community. Boasting a private pool and nestled a half-mile from beach access with a private boardwalk through Deer Lake State Park to the breathtaking, pristine beaches and turquoise water, this inviting property is perfect for relaxing, sun-soaked vacations. When not unwinding by the water, guests can take advantage of the resort-style amenities and Iconic 30A’s abundant family-friendly activities! Step inside this custom home to discover an inspired coastal setting, accented by classic beach materials of rattan, shiplap, and natural wood. The living space’s cloud-soft sofa, 2 barrel armchairs, and Smart TV encourage gathering for movie nights. Mere steps away, the gourmet kitchen features premium appliances and an expansive island. Imagine evenings preparing local seafood to share at the 5-seat dining table to the side, with additional seating at the breakfast bar. Out the French doors, breathe in the salt-tinged air from the comfortably furnished screened porch. For additional convenience, all the home’s bedrooms feature private bathrooms. Venture up the metal-and-wood staircase to find a second primary bedroom with a soft king bed, alongside a well-appointed office that doubles as a guest bedroom with a desk and queen sleeper sofa. A spiral staircase winds up to the cozy lookout tower—curl up with a book and enjoy the bird’s-eye view. The light-filled Carriage House boasts a full kitchen, 2-person bar, and a cozy living space, plus 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and private bathroom. Indulge in a peaceful, fun WaterSound West getaway at Captain’s Tower. For dedicated beach access, follow the boardwalk from the front porch, and enjoy a leisurely stroll to the sugar-white sands! The nearest public beach access is a 5-minute bike ride to Walton Dunes. On-site parking for up to 4 vehicles, a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, and 5 complimentary adult bikes make exploring 30A easy and convenient. Book today!
